# J123 numerical methods — Recovery capsule part 3/3

Same object identity as parts1–2: J123 actual-mass free-V whole-landscape continuation. Part1 is [internal-source-reference], part2 [internal-source-reference]. This final part completes the source/seed/checkpoint dependencies. The exact rational bodies and standalone full auditor are separately complete in [internal-source-reference]. No own110 construction is claimed.

This part preserves the complete exact generator/patch for both failed initial controls, the finite mass-fan diagnosis, and ALL coordinates of eight selected floating endpoints. The immutable parent for the initial exact seed is figure-0599; the chosen seed is also fully literal in the exact recovery material. No originating sandbox, KF optimizer archive or encoded archive is needed to use these points.

## Environment, replay and evidence limits
Python3.13.5, NumPy2.3.5, SciPy1.17.0, PyTorch2.10.0+cpu, float64, torch threads1; OMP_NUM_THREADS=1,OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1,MKL_NUM_THREADS=1. Save the following fenced units under their headings WITH terminal newline. Then run from the directory containing the part1/2 files:
```sh
python restore123.py
python joint123.py KF27G_QDESC_G4.txt joint_gauge30 30 .2 1e-6 .002 gauge
python jointwide123.py KF27G_QDESC_G4.txt jointwide_g100 100 .1 1e-6 .002 gauge
python jointcap123.py KF27G_QDESC_G4.txt jointcap_f150 150 .2 1e-6 .002 free
cp safecapA_points.json safecapA.json
python diagnose123.py
```
The restore command prints J123_ALL_FLOAT_INPUTS_AND_EXACT_CONTROL_PATCHES_RESTORED and all eight reconstructed point-file byte identities. Its patches were locally executed and confirmed to regenerate the complete original control-source bytes. These are exact patches with all helpers supplied in parts1–2, not isolated snippets.

The local-root squared-deficit run accepted no better feasible point beyond the initial seed; after30 requested/actual optimizer iterations its returned point was numerical S2/U12. The arbitrary widest-tree sum run ended after100 iterations with numerical S6/U19 and a gross directional finite-difference discrepancy because the chosen equally-wide tree could jump. Its scalar maximum-capacity replacement removed that objective-discontinuity mechanism but ended at iteration96 of150 requested, status8, numerical S5/U11; its best feasible point was again only the seed. Optimizer status or an improved objective was never admitted as actual feasibility.

The safeguarded continuation in parts1–2 separately admits only actual rebuilt-hull mass and physical-tree conditions. At the safecapA stopping point, the sampled boundary flips old triangles[0,9,32]/[8,9,32] to[0,8,9]/[0,8,32]. At alpha1e-5 the old-chart physical-guard derivative error is about1.13e-8, leaving the minimum actual guard below1e-6; at alpha1e-6 without this flip the error is about1.26e-15. This diagnoses a concrete finite chart issue, not global U1/S1 incompatibility. The exact flat-wall mass kernel is in the separate recovery material.

Full numerical workflow commands and actual finite terminations are in part1. For direct continuation any foo_points.json below is a complete input accepted by geometry123.load_points; no unrelated trace reconstruction is necessary. The JSON source preserves round-tripping decimal representations of the original binary64 coordinates, not an asserted rational own class. Complete numerical output JSONs contain elapsed time and their full-byte hashes are therefore not deterministic replay targets. Package/platform changes may also change optimizer trajectories. Exact G8 and coplanar endpoint claims instead use the literal rational material and exact audit.

## restore123.py
```python
"""Restore complete negative controls and all eight literal float checkpoints.
Requires jointwide123.py from part1 and J123_FLOAT_POINTS.json from part3.
The hashes below check byte reconstruction, not mathematical correctness.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json

def digest(data):return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
p=Path('jointwide123.py').read_text()
assert digest(p.encode())=='cf52389c39412f271240d618ce4b1b8d062b0d29acf99c01138e69f3b2385252'
old='            objective=(deficit*deficit).sum()\n'
assert p.count(old)==1
cap=p.replace(old,'            objective=deficit.max()**2\n')
assert digest(cap.encode())=='8d48be83ea7163c1791aa669093a102a3f61ec5dfd9ab980ff0f275561ea5a48'
Path('jointcap123.py').write_text(cap)
a=p.index('def widest_tree(q: torch.Tensor):\n');b=p.index('class Joint:',a)
local=p[:a]+p[b:]
old='            qr,qp=widest_tree(q)\n            scores=reference_tree_guards(q,qr,qp)\n            deficit=torch.relu(self.tauq-scores)\n'
new='            scores=angular(q).max(dim=1).values\n            qr=int(torch.argmax((q*q).sum(dim=1)).detach())\n            keep=torch.arange(len(q))!=qr\n            deficit=torch.relu(self.tauq-scores[keep])\n'
assert local.count(old)==1
local=local.replace(old,new)
assert digest(local.encode())=='903d088b1a455baed1d86eea3823541cd997fafef950bb9f96ee8502f58de49f'
Path('joint123.py').write_text(local)
b=Path('J123_FLOAT_POINTS.json').read_bytes()
assert digest(b)=='a15d7e7adead82a1036aaaa5af003d86d920b219e0fe4eaff80ac71045528cba'
d=json.loads(b)
for name,points in d.items():
    out=(json.dumps({'points':points},sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))+'\n').encode()
    Path(name+'_points.json').write_bytes(out)
    print(name+'_points.json',len(out),digest(out))
print('J123_ALL_FLOAT_INPUTS_AND_EXACT_CONTROL_PATCHES_RESTORED')
```

## diagnose123.py
```python
import numpy as np,torch,json
from scipy.optimize import minimize
from safecap123 import values
from geometry123 import load_points,triangulate,live_values,angular,reference_tree_guards
x=load_points('safecapA.json');a=values(x,True);n=len(x)*3-3;np_=len(a['p']);nq=len(a['q']);J=a['jac'];cap=a['capacity'];tau=1e-6
A=np.zeros((np_+nq+1,n+1));A[:,:n]=J;A[np_:np_+nq,n]=-1;b=np.r_[a['p']-tau,a['q']-cap,a['volume']*.95]
s=minimize(lambda y:(.5*(y[:-1]@y[:-1])-y[-1],np.r_[y[:-1],-1]),np.zeros(n+1),jac=True,method='SLSQP',bounds=[(-.01,.01)]*n+[(-.01,.05)],constraints=[{'type':'ineq','fun':lambda y:A@y+b,'jac':lambda y:A}],options={'ftol':1e-12,'maxiter':200})
d=s.x[:-1].reshape(-1,3);trace=[]
for al in [1, .1,.01,.001,.0001,.00001,.000001,.0000001,-1e-5]:
 xx=x.copy();xx[a['ids']]+=al*d
 try:
  c=values(xx);tr,fa,_,_=triangulate(xx);vv,g,p,q=live_values(torch.tensor(xx),tr,fa)
  pg=reference_tree_guards(p,a['rootP'],a['parentsP']).numpy()
  oldfa={tuple(sorted(map(int,t))) for t in a['faces']};newfa={tuple(sorted(map(int,t))) for t in fa}
  row={'alpha':al,'newP':min(c['p']),'oldP':min(pg),'capacity_change':c['capacity']-cap,'prediction':al*s.x[-1],'old_P_change_error':float(max(abs(pg-(a['p']+al*J[:np_]@d.ravel())))),'new_faces':sorted(newfa-oldfa),'removed_faces':sorted(oldfa-newfa)}
 except Exception as e:row={'alpha':al,'error':str(e)}
 trace.append(row)
print(json.dumps(trace,indent=2));open('diagnose123.json','w').write(json.dumps(trace,indent=2)+'\n')
```
